license_required.quote: No person shall practice or offer to practice dentistry in New Hampshire or use any title, sign, card, device or the abbreviation D.M.D. or D.D.S., or any other designation indicating that such person is practicing dentistry unless such person has been licensed under the provisions of this chapter.

issuing_authority.value: Office of Professional Licensure and Certification
issuing_authority.quote: Applications for licensure to practice dentistry shall be made to the office of professional licensure and certification

name.quote: the board shall adopt rules, pursuant to RSA 541-A

type.quote: The board shall adopt rules, pursuant to RSA 541-A, relative to: ... The qualifications of applicants

age_minimum.quote: The applicant shall be of good professional character and 18 years of age or older.

moral_character_required.quote: The applicant shall be of good professional character

degree_required.value: D.D.S. or D.M.D. from a CODA-accredited school
degree_required.quote: satisfactory proof that the applicant is a graduate of a school that is recognized by the Commission on Dental Accreditation (CODA) and holds the degree of D.D.S. or D.M.D.

accrediting_body.quote: a school that is recognized by the Commission on Dental Accreditation (CODA)

exams.name: National or regional examination
exams.jurisdiction: national or regional test approved by the board
exams.quote: Applicants for a license to practice dentistry or dental hygiene shall pass an examination as determined by the board or have successfully passed a national or regional test approved by the board.

interval_years.quote: License renewals and notifications shall be issued in accordance with RSA 310:8.

required.quote: Continuing education requirements for licensees and holders of certificates

available.quote: All boards or commissions shall grant a license to an individual certified or licensed in another state if it determines that the requirements or standards for certification or licensure in that state are equivalent to, or greater than, those established in New Hampshire.

requirements.value: Requirements or standards for certification or licensure in another state must be equivalent to or greater than New Hampshire requirements
requirements.quote: All boards or commissions shall grant a license to an individual certified or licensed in another state if it determines that the requirements or standards for certification or licensure in that state are equivalent to, or greater than, those established in New Hampshire.

exists.quote: A dental hygienists committee is established, which shall consist of one dental hygienist member of the board, one dentist member of the board, and 3 additional dental hygienist members appointed by the governor and council.

name.quote: A dental hygienists committee is established

authority.value: advisory only; develops and proposes administrative rules for board consideration
authority.quote: The committee shall develop and propose the administrative rules regarding the practice, education, examination, and licensure of dental hygienists, for the board's consideration pursuant to RSA 317-A:12. The committee shall have no independent regulatory or disciplinary authority.

credential_type.quote: any person practicing or offering to practice dentistry in New Hampshire must submit evidence that such person is qualified to so practice and shall be licensed as provided in this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Addiction to mind-altering drugs or intoxicants
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Addiction to mind-altering drugs or intoxicants.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commission of any felony or misdemeanor involving dishonesty, untrustworthiness, or unprofessional conduct
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Commission of any felony or misdemeanor involving dishonesty, untrustworthiness, or unprofessional conduct

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any administrative or criminal conviction involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any administrative or criminal conviction involving moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practice of fraud or untruthfulness in obtaining educational credentials, examination scores, or professional licensure
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The practice of fraud or untruthfulness in obtaining educational credentials, examination scores, or professional licensure in this or any other jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Affliction with a physical or mental impairment or disease which is dangerous to the public health or which precludes the practice of dentistry at ordinary levels of proficiency
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Affliction with a physical or mental impairment or disease which is dangerous to the public health or which precludes the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene at ordinary levels of proficiency.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Ignorance, incompetence, or a pattern of behavior inconsistent with the basic knowledge and skills expected of persons licensed to practice dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Ignorance, incompetence, or a pattern of behavior inconsistent with the basic knowledge and skills expected of persons licensed to practice dentistry or dental hygiene.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross or repeated negligence in practicing dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross or repeated negligence in practicing dentistry or dental hygiene.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intentionally injuring a patient or engaging in any other unprofessional or dishonest conduct in practicing dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Intentionally injuring a patient or engaging in any other unprofessional or dishonest conduct in practicing dentistry or dental hygiene.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to follow the current guidelines of the American Dental Association regarding radiographic examinations and infection control
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to follow the current guidelines of: The American Dental Association, as adopted, in whole or in part, by the board, as published in: Dental Radiographic Examinations: Recommendations for Patient Selection and Limiting Radiation Exposure; and Recommendations in Radiographic Practices.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to follow the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention infection control recommendations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention as published in Infection Control Recommendations.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising the dental practice by using deceptive messages concerning dental services, techniques, qualifications, or prices
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising the licensee's dental practice by using any newspaper, broadcast, cable transmission, telephone, sign, poster, or other advertising message which: Deceives or is intended to deceive the public concerning dental services, techniques, the qualifications of a licensee, or the prices to be charged

disciplinary_grounds.description: Claiming or suggesting professional superiority or performing services in a manner superior to other licensed dentists
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Claims or suggests that the licensee enjoys professional superiority or performs services in a manner superior to other persons licensed by this chapter or that the licensee performs services or any particular service in a painless manner

disciplinary_grounds.description: Announcing the use of any drug or medicine of an unknown formula or any system or anesthetic that is unnamed, misnamed, misrepresented, or not in reality used
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Announces the use of any drug or medicine of an unknown formula or any system or anesthetic that is unnamed, misnamed, misrepresented, or not in reality used.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing or permitting an unlicensed person to practice in the licensee's office
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employing or permitting an unlicensed person to practice in the licensee's office.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly or willfully violating any provision of the dentistry chapter, any substantive rule or order of the dental board, or any federal, state, or local controlled drug law or other laws pertaining to the practice of dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly or willfully violating any provision of this chapter, any substantive rule or order of the dental board, any federal, state, or local controlled drug law or other federal, state, or local laws or regulations pertaining to: The practice of dentistry, and the Principles of Ethics and Code of Professional Conduct of the American Dental Association as reviewed and approved, in whole or in part, by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having more than one patient undergoing moderate sedation, deep sedation, or general anesthesia on an outpatient basis at any given time unless each patient is being continuously monitored on a one-to-one ratio
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having more than one patient undergoing moderate sedation, deep sedation, or general anesthesia on an outpatient basis at any given time unless each patient is being continuously monitored on a one-to-one ratio while sedated by either the dentist or another licensed health professional authorized by law to administer moderate sedation, deep sedation, or general anesthesia.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to have patients recovering from moderate sedation, deep sedation, or general anesthesia closely monitored by licensed health professionals experienced in care and resuscitation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to have patients recovering from moderate sedation, deep sedation, or general anesthesia closely monitored by licensed health professionals experienced in the care and resuscitation of patients recovering from moderate sedation, deep sedation, or general anesthesia.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to have patients continuously monitored with a pulse oximeter or similar monitoring equipment while undergoing or recovering from moderate sedation, deep sedation, or general anesthesia
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to have patients continuously monitored with a pulse oximeter or similar or superior monitoring equipment required by the board while undergoing or recovering from moderate sedation, deep sedation, or general anesthesia.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to perform an adequate history and physical or to obtain written informed consent prior to administering general anesthesia, deep sedation, or moderate sedation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to perform an adequate history and physical as defined in rules under RSA 317-A:12, XII-a(h) or to obtain the written informed consent of a patient prior to the administering general anesthesia, deep sedation, or moderate sedation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report an adverse event or implement a corrective action plan as required by RSA 317-A:20-a
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to report an adverse event or implement a corrective action plan as required by RSA 317-A:20-a.

definition_quote.value: A person shall be regarded as practicing dentistry within the meaning of this chapter who: (a) Uses or permits to be used, directly or indirectly, for profit or otherwise, for that person or for any other person, in connection with the person's name, the word 'dentist', or 'dental surgeon', or the title 'D.D.S.' or 'D.M.D.', or any other words, letters, titles, or descriptive matter, personal or not, which directly or indirectly imply the practice of dentistry; (b) Owns, leases, maintains, or operates a dental business in any office or other room or rooms where dental operations are performed, or directly or indirectly is manager, proprietor, or conductor of the same; (c) Directly or indirectly informs the public in any language, orally, in writing, or in printing, or by drawings, demonstrations, specimens, signs, or pictures that the person can perform or will attempt to perform dental operations of any kind; (d) Undertakes, by any means or method, including by use of electronic media, gratuitously or for a salary, fee, money, or other reward paid or granted directly or indirectly to that person or to any other person, to diagnose or profess to diagnose, to treat or profess to treat, or prescribe for or profess to prescribe for any of the lesions, diseases, disorders, or deficiencies of the human oral cavity, teeth, gums, maxilla, or mandible or adjacent associated structures; (e) Supervises a dentist within the scope of the practice of dentistry; (f) Except on the written prescription of a duly licensed dentist and by the use of impressions or casts made by a duly licensed and practicing dentist, directly or indirectly by mail, carrier, personal agent, or by any other method, furnishes, supplies, constructs, reproduces, or repairs prosthetic dentures, bridges, appliances, or other structures to be used and worn as substitutes for natural teeth, or adjusts the same; (g) Administers dental anesthetics, either general or local; or (h) Dispenses teeth whitening agents or undertakes to whiten or bleach teeth by any means or method, unless the person is dispensing or using a product that may be purchased over the counter for the person's own use, or is authorized under rules adopted by the board to engage in such activities without being a licensed dentist.
definition_quote.quote: A person shall be regarded as practicing dentistry within the meaning of this chapter who: (a) Uses or permits to be used, directly or indirectly, for profit or otherwise... (h) Dispenses teeth whitening agents or undertakes to whiten or bleach teeth by any means or method

value: administration of dental anesthetics (general or local)

Administers dental anesthetics, either general or local; or Dispenses teeth whitening agents or undertakes to whiten or bleach teeth

drug_authority.value: Dentists may prescribe controlled drugs pursuant to RSA 318-B:41 as determined by board rules
drug_authority.quote: Prescribing controlled drugs pursuant to RSA 318-B:41

sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.quote: The use of general anesthesia, deep sedation, and moderate sedation, in dental treatment under RSA 317-A:20, including: ... The use of minimal anesthesia in patients undergoing dental treatment under RSA 317-A:20

sedation_permit_onsite_inspection_requir.quote: On-site evaluations of personnel, facility, equipment, and records as they pertain to the use of required drugs, general anesthesia, deep sedation, or moderate sedation, or any combination thereof.

sedation_adverse_event_reporting_require.quote: Any dentist licensed pursuant to this chapter shall report to the board the occurrence of any adverse health care events resulting in death, brain damage, or hospitalization, occurring in the dentist's office or facility while utilizing general anesthesia, deep sedation, or moderate sedation, as soon as is reasonably and practically possible, but no later than 15 working days after discovery of the event.

pediatric_sedation_endorsement_required.quote: Administration of general anesthesia or deep sedation to patients under the age of 13 shall be subject to additional rules including: In addition to the dentist performing the procedure, there shall be a dedicated anesthesia provider present to monitor the procedure and recovery from anesthesia.

specialist_license_available.quote: All advertisements of dental services shall contain the name of the dentist whose services are being advertised and shall state whether each dentist is a general dentist or, if qualified, a specialist in the named area or specialization.

dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: Dental hygiene services shall be provided under the supervision of a licensed dentist in accordance with rules adopted by the board. ... A certified public health dental hygienist, acting under the public health supervision of an actively licensed dentist, may practice in a school, hospital, or other institution, or for a homebound person without the dentist having to be present

advanced_practice_permit_available.quote: A dental hygienist licensed under this chapter may obtain a certification to practice as a certified public health dental hygienist by submitting an application to the office of professional licensure and certification and completing additional educational and training requirements as required by the board.

advanced_practice_eligible_patient_popul.quote: A certified public health dental hygienist, acting under the public health supervision of an actively licensed dentist, may practice in a school, hospital, or other institution, or for a homebound person without the dentist having to be present

dental_office_ownership_restrictions.quote: Dentists acting as a manager, proprietor, partnership, association, or corporation owning, managing, or controlling any place where dental work is done, provided, or contracted for shall employ, keep, or retain only licensed dentists to practice dentistry and licensed dental hygienists to practice dental hygiene.

teledentistry_authorized.quote: Persons licensed by the board shall be permitted to provide services through the use of "telemedicine", as defined in RSA 310:7.

hygienist_local_anesthesia_certification.quote: The administration of local anesthesia, provided the dental hygienist is qualified by the board after training and after passing an examination approved by the board.

hygienist_nitrous_oxide_certification_re.quote: The administration of nitrous oxide/oxygen minimal sedation (anxiolysis); provided the dental hygienist is qualified by the board after training and after passing an examination approved by the board.

patient_record_retention_years.quote: A dentist shall maintain patients' paper or electronic, and radiographic records, for at least 7 years from the time the dentist or dental hygienist last treated the patient. In the case of a minor patient, a dentist shall maintain a patient's paper or electronic, and radiographic dental records for at least 7 years past the age of majority.

cpr_certification_required_for_sedation.quote: The dentist shall be trained in pediatric advanced life support (PALS) and airway management, equivalent to the American Academy of Pediatrics and American Academy of Pediatric Dentistry (AAP-AAPD) guidelines or equivalent as determined by the board.

dental_hygienist_alternative_practice_li.quote: A dental hygienist licensed under this chapter may obtain a certification to practice as a certified public health dental hygienist
